title: FossóSMP S5
description: FossóSMP is a Minecraft server hosted and played on by Sharppaws for all of my friends and friends friends to enjoy!
body:
FossoSMP is a friendly community server for people who enjoy calm minecraft gameplay more centered around farming, creating and meeting new people. We only want people who will be commited to the server and want to play. For rules its just dont kill or grief outside of wars that have been signed by both willing sides to keep things fun also cheating in any for is strictly prohibited. 

If the description has any grammar flaws its cause english isnt my first language.
